headline: Mistakes People Make When Cleaning Up Smoke Damage
articleBody: When faced with smoke damage, it's natural to want to clean it up yourself. However, a few common mistakes can actually make things worse. Firstly, never use standard household cleaners or water on soot-covered surfaces. This can smear the soot, driving it deeper into materials and causing permanent stains. Secondly, don't delay the cleanup; smoke residue becomes more difficult to remove the longer it sits, leading to etching and discoloration. Thirdly, overlooking the HVAC system is a big one; if smoke has entered your ventilation, it will continue to spread odors and contaminants throughout your home. Lastly, trying to clean porous items like upholstered furniture or drapes without specialized equipment often leads to disappointing results and lingering smells.
